title: 别碰那个开关  (Don't Touch That Switch)

segments.t: Back at the threshold of Room 9, Chen opens his leather tool bag to inspect the old brass wall switch, but an excited Manager Zhou reaches past him beside Qing. Listen first.
周经理，等一分钟，先别碰那个铜开关。
等什么？我记得这个玻璃灯——你们看它多漂亮！
周经理，等等——老陈已经拿出螺丝刀了！
就按一下——啪！……哎呀。
刚才走廊里是什么声音？真响！
是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
糟糕——我听到小美在厨房里叫我们！
老板，这是三十年的老电线。我检查以前，千万别按开关。
老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
厨房两分钟就能好，可是九号房要换新的铜电线。
周经理，拿稳手电筒——只剩六天了！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
周经理，等一分钟，先别碰那个铜开关。
'Manager Zhou, wait a minute—don't touch that brass switch yet.'
等什么？我记得这个玻璃灯——你们看它多漂亮！
'Wait for what? I remember this glass lamp—look how pretty it is!'
周经理，等等——老陈已经拿出螺丝刀了！
'Manager Zhou, wait—Chen already has his screwdriver out!'
就按一下——啪！……哎呀。
'Just one quick click—pop! ... Oh dear.'
刚才走廊里是什么声音？真响！
'What was that sound in the hallway just now? So loud!'
是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
'It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.'
大厅的灯黑了！我把厨房的烤箱也弄坏了吗？
'The lobby lamp went dark! Did I break the kitchen oven too?'
糟糕——我听到小美在厨房里叫我们！
'Uh-oh—I can hear Mei calling us from the kitchen!'
老板，这是三十年的老电线。我检查以前，千万别按开关。
'Boss, this wire is thirty years old. Never flip a switch before I check it.'
老陈，午饭以前能修好吗？你有新的保险丝吧？
'Chen, can you fix it before lunch? You do have new fuses, right?'
厨房两分钟就能好，可是九号房要换新的铜电线。
'The kitchen will be fine in two minutes, but Room Nine needs new copper wire.'
周经理，拿稳手电筒——只剩六天了！
'Hold the flashlight steady, Manager Zhou—only six days left!'

One impatient click from Manager Zhou pops the ground-floor fuse and proves Room 9 needs fresh wiring before Friday. That's the end of this episode, so see you in the next one.
下次见！
